body:
I ran into this issue last night when I was tired and I spent a bit of time chasing my tail before understanding what was going on.

I don't claim that my PR (#847) is the proper way forward, but it works for me. If there's a better way to do it, I'll be happy to help if I can, but it does seem like being able to use binary-only formats with WebSockets is worthwhile.

Similarly, I don't know that having a separate `CborPacked` is better than having some other way to request that `to_vec_packed` is used instead of `to_vec`. 

I thought about submitting two PRs, but they would both be touching the same area of code, so I figure this is probably the getter way to proceed.

issue.title: Allow binary-only formats (e.g., CBOR) with websockets

repository.name: yew
repository.description: Rust / Wasm framework for creating reliable and efficient web applications

issue.body:
Fixes: #389

This allows the various formats that can't be converted in or out of Text to be used in the callback that a websocket will use.
